files.patch: @@ -1,6 +1,219 @@ #!/usr/bin/env ruby # frozen_string_literal: true +=begin +2links - URL Extractor, Canonicalizer, and Deduplicator +======================================================== + +## SPECIFICATION + +2links is a command-line tool that extracts, normalizes, and deduplicates URLs from +text input. It canonicalizes URLs to a standard form and removes duplicates that point +to the same resource, preferring HTTPS over HTTP and sorting output alphabetically. + +## SUPPORTED SCHEMES + +- http:// and https:// +- ftp:// + +## CONTRACT + +### Input +- Plain text with embedded URLs (any supported scheme) +- Optional HTML with href="..." attributes (with --html flag) +- Accepts from stdin or file argument +- Max URL length: 2048 characters (standard) + +### Processing Pipeline +1. **Extraction:** Regex scan for plain text URLs + optional HTML href parsing +2. **Validation:** URI.parse() with strict scheme whitelist +3. **Canonicalization:** Normalize scheme/host/path, strip trailing slashes +4. **Deduplication:** Group by scheme-agnostic key, prefer https +5. **Sorting:** Alphabetical by canonical URL +6. **Output:** Text (default) or JSON format + +### Canonicalization Rules + +1. Parse URL with URI.parse() +2. Validate scheme (http|https|ftp only) +3. Lowercase scheme and hostname +4. Strip trailing slash (except for root "/") +5. Query params/fragments: PRESERVED in original, OMITTED in canonical key +6. User info (user:pass@): STRIPPED and WARNED +7. Default ports omitted (80→http, 443→https, 21→ftp) + +### Deduplication Logic + +- **Key:** Scheme-agnostic (host:port/path) +- **Preference:** HTTPS > HTTP > FTP +- **Fallback:** Count most common representation + +Example: + Input: https://github.com/user/repo + http://github.com/user/repo + https://github.com/user/repo/ + Output: https://github.com/user/repo (single canonical, https preferred) + +### Output Formats + +#### Text (default) +One canonical URL per line, sorted alphabetically. +Clean, Unix-friendly, easily piped. + +#### JSON (--format json) +Array of objects with: + { + "canonical_url": "https://...", + "domain": "example.com", + "count": 2, + "variations": ["https://...", "http://..."] # optional with --variations + } + +## USAGE + +### Basic Examples + + # Extract from file + ./2links urls.txt + + # Extract from stdin + cat page.html | ./2links + + # Extract from file with stats + ./2links input.txt --verbose + + # JSON output with variations + ./2links urls.txt --format json --variations + + # Parse HTML href attributes + ./2links page.html --html + + # Extract and filter by domain + ./2links urls.txt --filter github.com + + # Exclude internal IPs + ./2links mixed_urls.txt --no-internal + +### Command-Line Options + + -f, --format FORMAT Output format: text|json (default: text) + -H, --html Parse HTML href="..." attributes + -F, --filter DOMAIN Filter URLs by domain (supports partial match) + -o, --output FILE Write output to file instead of stdout + -v, --verbose Show statistics, warnings, and counts + -V, --variations Include URL variations in JSON output + --no-internal Exclude localhost and private IP addresses + -h, --help Show help message + --version Show version + +## EDGE CASES & WARNINGS + +### Detected Issues (with --verbose) + +- **Internal IPs:** localhost, 127.x, 192.168.x, 10.x, 172.16-31.x +- **User Info in URLs:** user:pass@host (stripped, warned) +- **Invalid URLs:** Logged but skipped (doesn't halt processing) +- **Malformed Input:** Continues gracefully, reports counts + +### Statistics Reported + +- URLs found (regex matches) +- URLs valid (parse successful) +- URLs invalid (parse failed) +- Unique canonical URLs +- Total variations (all original forms) +- Internal IP detections +- User info detections + +## DESIGN DECISIONS + +| Decision | Rationale | +|----------|-----------| +| Scheme-agnostic dedup key | Allows http/https equivalence without false positives | +| HTTPS preference | Security-aware default, aligns with modern practices | +| Query params in identity | Omitted (canonical URLs are stable targets, params are ephemeral) | +| No network I/O | Offline operation: fast, secure, no external dependencies | +| Stateful class design | Maintains state for chaining, multi-call workflows | +| Optional HTML parsing | Flexibility without breaking plain-text use case | + +## EXAMPLES + +### Example 1: Basic Text Extraction + + Input: + Check https://github.com/user/repo + Old link: http://github.com/user/repo + + Command: + $ ./2links input.txt + + Output: + https://github.com/user/repo + +### Example 2: HTML Parsing + + Input: + Example + Visit https://example.com for details + + Command: + $ ./2links page.html --html --format json --variations + + Output: + [ + { + "canonical_url": "https://example.com", + "domain": "example.com", + "count": 2, + "variations": ["https://example.com"] + } + ] + +### Example 3: Filtering and Stats + + Command: + $ ./2links urls.txt --filter github --verbose --no-internal + + Output: + https://github.com/user/repo1 + https://github.com/user/repo2 + + [2links] Statistics: + URLs found: 47 + URLs valid: 45 + URLs invalid: 2 + Unique canonical URLs: 23 + Total variations: 45 + Internal IPs detected: 3 + +## ROADMAP + +### Phase 5 (In Progress) +- ✅ --output flag for file output +- ✅ --filter flag for domain/scheme filtering +- ⚠️ --no-internal flag to exclude private IPs +- Future: --base-url for relative URL resolution + +### Phase 6 (Planned) +- Full Nokogiri HTML parsing (not just href) +- Markdown link extraction +- robots.txt / sitemap.xml support +- Bulk file processing + +### Phase 7+ (Long-term) +- Web crawler mode +- Database persistence +- API/HTTP server mode +- Parallel processing + +## VERSION + +2links 1.0.0 +Ruby 3.0+ +No external dependencies (pure stdlib) + +=end + require 'uri' require 'set' require 'optparse'
